scope: Independent headless Edge browser-process trees with synthetic API responses. Same shared Windows workload; excludes Java/native backend CPU and process memory. Hidden visibility is emulated; browser throttling is not.
samplingLimit: CPU between the last sample and a process exit may be missed; raw process IDs retained.
workload: Shared development machine with concurrent native/backend build and startup validation; concurrent independent baseline/candidate browser instances.
